subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving selective reply routing to existing deterministic routing or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but prompt-driven channel-selective replies would change channel delivery policy and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep this issue or a follow-up open for an explicit maintainer-approved API/prompt direction around channel-selective replies.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Chosen Routing
options.body: Document that routing remains host-controlled and close or narrow the broader selective-routing request once metadata parity is handled.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` only.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and existing maintainer-side scope comment make this the clearest owner for the prompt-metadata versus delivery-policy choice.
